title: DOXYCYCLINE PENETRATION INTO BONE AND JOINT.
official: DOXYCYCLINE PENETRATION INTO BONE AND JOINT.
summary:
Main objective: The objective of this study is to provide robust data on bone penetration of the doxycycline in non-infected patient. 
The primary objective is to determine the penetration of doxycycline in cancellous bone.
conditions: Patients requiring total hip arthroplasty for coxofemoral osteoarthritis
Other infections involving bone in diseases classified elsewhere site unspecified

interventions.name: DOXYCYCLINE BIOGARAN 100 mg, comprimé pelliculé sécable

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. -	Age between 18 and 80 years old.
2. -	Scheduled for elective surgery for hip replacement due to coxarthrosis
3. -	Signed informed consent
4. -	Patients eligible for French social insurance
5. Participants able to fully understand the study and who accept its requirements and constraints
Exclusion criteria:
1. •	Patients with contraindications to doxycycline ( hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients (particularly as generic formulations are authorized in the study and excipients may therefore differ), hypersensitivity to tetracycline-class antibiotics, co-administration of retinoids, or vitamin A supplementation exceeding 10,000 IU/day, due to the risk of intracranial hypertension and intestinal obstruction).
2. -	Patient with a contraindication to surgical procedure
3. -	history of osteoarticular infection related to hip prosthesis surgery
4. -	Patient who has received antibiotics within one month prior to the procedure
5. •	Patient who did not take Doxycycline as planned in the protocol.
6. •	Patient being a relative of the investigator or any member of the team directly involved in the study, including assistant physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and coordinators.
7. -	malabsorption syndrome or conditions likely to impair antibiotic absorption (sleevs, colectomy, gastrointestinal antacids (magnesium, aluminum, or calcium salts, oxides, or hydroxides) and oral iron salts……)
8. -	Malnutrition patient (BMI < 21 kg/m2) or with serum albumin < 30g/L
9. -	Kidney failure with GFR < 60 mL/min/1,73m2
10. -	Patients unable to take oral doxycycline
11. -	Pregnant or breastfeeding women
12. •	Women of childbearing age without effective contraception : childbearing age means non menopausal women. Effective contraception includes taking a contraceptive pill or using an Intra Uterine Device.
13. -	Patients under guardianship, curatorship, legal protection or conservatorship
14. -	Patient with an infection at the time of surgical management
